description: Find where fonts are used in the document. fonts_used[] {family, style, status (installed, substituted, not_available), occurrences, characters} is always complete; occurrences[] {family, style, status, story_id, frame_ids[], page_id, page_name, is_master, start_index, end_index, snippet} is filtered by font_family and font_style (exact names, case-insensitive – "Futura" does not match "Futura PT"), only_missing (status other than installed) and include_master_pages (default true). Runs of the same family and style are merged; at most 500 occurrences are listed. Read-only.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

font_family.description: Family to filter occurrences by (case-insensitive; a format suffix such as "(OTF)" may be left out).

font_style.description: Style to filter occurrences by (exact, case-insensitive).

include_master_pages.description: Include stories on master pages. Default true.

only_missing.description: List only occurrences of fonts that are not installed. Default false.

name: find_font_usage
title: Where is a font used
